name: gradient-young-passion
title: Young Passion
description: A decorative horizontal gradient block that starts in warm coral pink and deepens to berry magenta, with soft rounded corners and no content of its own.
use: A warm coral-to-berry wash is needed behind a hero, card or banner.
avoid: It is flat colour with no motion, and white text on the magenta end may lose contrast.
a11y: Purely decorative: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information on its own. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rectangular band with softly rounded corners, filled by a left-to-right gradient that begins in coral pink and deepens to berry magenta at the right edge. Even black margins surround it.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The colour stops are fixed, though extra classes or inline styles can repaint and resize it.
customise: The gradient stops sit in the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight: light: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.
polishWhy: Smooth, cleanly rounded gradient; it is still just a stock two-colour wash.
